chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Rio, 2021: the Copa América final against Brazil. Rodrigo De Paul sends a long pass from his own half. Di María races in behind... and lifts it over the keeper! One nil to Argentina!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. The pass flies past the defender, Renan Lodi. One touch with his left foot, and it’s his. Here comes the keeper, rushing out!

chapters.label: The chip
chapters.text: So Di María does not blast it. He chips it gently over Ederson... and it drops into the net!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when the keeper rushes out, stay calm. Lift the ball gently over them!
